svg.title: L2 Front - pin ladder
svg.text: One block per housing, one row per cavity. Every wire runs straight from its cavity to where it lands. Read left to right.
Splice at the nose → 14 AWG branch to each lamp plug, terminal RY
Splice at the nose → 14 AWG branch to each lamp plug, terminal RL
Splice at the nose → 12 AWG branch to motor E-03 terminal WR and motor E-04 terminal WR, as the
headlights on L2-P 1 / 2 (D-487; one feed per motor until then) - each motor's own relay switches it
and its cam stops it (SP-584; confirm at CK08)
Motor E-03 terminal RY - the down command into the motor's own relay (SP-584, D-460); N14 at the
node. A command, not the motor current, but behind O1's 25 A soft fuse, so 14 AWG; in the power
plug because the signal plug had one spare cavity for four commands (D-487)
Splice at the nose → each horn's terminal GY
Front combo lamp F-05, terminal GR
Front combo lamp F-06, terminal GO
Splice at the nose → F-05 RG, F-06 RG, F-12 RG, F-13 RG
Wiper park feed — future motor family
L2-M-8 · 16 AWG RED · RT09 · capped at the far end
Held as the fused park feed a self-parking motor needs; block A position F13 is its protection when
Motor E-03 terminal R - the up command into the motor's own relay (SP-584, D-460); N12 at the
node; 14 AWG behind O1's 25 A soft fuse (D-487). Was A4's transit contact with its 3.3 kΩ and 47 kΩ
baseline: YG is capped at the motor, and the PMU reads a moving lamp from O1's current
Motor E-04 terminal R - the up command (SP-584, D-460); N13 at the node; 14 AWG (D-487). Was A5's
transit contact: YG is capped at the motor
47 kΩ baseline to the front star ground at the L2-S plug (D-368; A4 / A5's baselines are at the
inhibitor switch since D-487) - covers the run to the park contact; a break in the brake branch reads
as brake never pressed. Wiper motor D-02 park terminal L through 12 kΩ. Terminal LB is left
Wiper park return — future motor family
L2-S-4 · 16 AWG GRY · RT09 · capped at the far end
Run to the wiper branch and left unpinned there: a DIN 72552 motor's park return is pinned into
this cavity at the branch, no leg re-run (D-317)
L2-S-5 · 16 AWG GRY · RT08 · capped at the far end
L2-OAT 1 — the outside-air sensor receptacle ahead of the radiator, dust-capped; the thermistor's
other lead grounds at the front star (D-256 → D-329, D-274)
Motor E-04 terminal RY - the down command (SP-584, D-460); N15 at the node; 14 AWG (D-487). Was
L2-OAT-1 · 16 AWG GRY · capped at the far end
Dust-capped receptacle at the nose — the thermistor plugs in, its return to the front star (D-274)
L2-R-1 · 16 AWG GRY · RT29 · capped at the far end
L2-R-2 · 16 AWG GRY · RT29 · capped at the far end
L2-R-3 · 16 AWG GRY · RT29 · capped at the far end
L2-RDR · DT06-4S · Nose, behind the front bumper
Radar front sensor A, nose end
L2-RDR-1 · 16 AWG GRY · RT29 · capped at the far end
Dust-capped behind the bumper; the front sensor's lead plugs in when Z-002 picks it (A16)
Radar front sensor B, nose end
L2-RDR-2 · 16 AWG GRY · RT29 · capped at the far end
Dust-capped behind the bumper; the front sensor's lead plugs in when Z-002 picks it (A16)
Radar front sensor C, nose end
L2-RDR-3 · 16 AWG GRY · RT29 · capped at the far end
Dust-capped behind the bumper; the front sensor's lead plugs in when Z-002 picks it (A16)
Solid wire: live. Dashed: run and capped at the far end. A box on a wire is an inline resistor. Generated by rx7.py diagrams - do not edit.
